subject.title: fix(auto-reply): preserve Unicode in context treemap label truncation

question: Should context-treemap labels remain intentionally ASCII-sanitized, or should the renderer preserve Unicode labels end-to-end?
rationale: The branch safely hardens an otherwise unreachable helper, but accepting it as a product fix depends on whether Unicode labels are a supported treemap output contract.

options.title: Keep the current ASCII contract
options.body: Close or narrow this PR because current rendering removes non-ASCII labels before truncation, leaving no present user-facing defect.

options.title: Support Unicode labels end-to-end
options.body: Retain a bounded follow-up that changes the sanitizer/render contract, chooses grapheme-aware display limits, and proves a Unicode label in `/context map`.

recommendation.title: Keep the current ASCII contract
recommendation.body: Close or narrow this PR because current rendering removes non-ASCII labels before truncation, leaving no present user-facing defect.
